mission.text: Tiwára’s House is a booking platform for afro hair care.
We’re here to modernise a process that has looked the same for years,
and to give stylists the tools to grow.

milestones.title: Braiding from a young age
milestones.description: Kashope Afolabi picked up braiding young, doing hair for family and friends long before it was ever a business.

milestones.title: Kashope meets Grace
milestones.description: The two meet at the University of Manchester. Grace sees the vision early and partners with Kashope to bring it to life.

milestones.title: Braiding alongside the day job
milestones.description: Kashope keeps braiding while working full time, and sees how little the process around an appointment has changed.

milestones.title: All in
milestones.description: Kashope leaves her job to build Tiwára’s House full time.

milestones.title: Learning in Lagos
milestones.description: She travels to Lagos, Nigeria to learn more about hair: the craft, the techniques and the people behind them.

milestones.title: Tiwára’s House launches
milestones.description: We open as a booking platform for afro hair stylists all over the UK.

milestones.title: Just the beginning
milestones.description: Booking is where we start. It leads to so much more.
